jobs.description: This internship is primarily intended as a learning experience and is designed to provide practical experience in data management, digitalisation, process improvement, and organisational IT systems within a small international organisation.At the beginning of the internship, you and your internship supervisor will establish a structured internship plan with clear learning objectives, expected outcomes, and personal development goals. Throughout the internship, you will receive regular supervision, coaching, and feedback. Progress and learning objectives will be reviewed periodically to support your professional development.The internship focuses on understanding how data, digital tools, and workflows are used within EFFoST and on developing practical solutions to improve organisational effectiveness.Internship structureDuring the first phase of the internship, you will familiarise yourself with the organisation, its systems, and its data processes. As part of your learning trajectory, you will analyse current practices and identify opportunities for improvement, including:- Mapping current data flows and information processes- Understanding how different files, databases, and data sources are used- Identifying inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement- Evaluating the current use of digital tools- Developing proposals for improved workflows and practical automationBased on these analyses, you will develop a digitalisation project proposal as part of your internship objectives. Together with your supervisor, you will determine which activities can be implemented during the internship period and how these support your learning goals.During the second phase of the internship, you will gain practical experience by contributing to selected digitalisation initiatives, data-related projects, and workflow improvements. These activities will be carried out under supervision and as part of the agreed internship plan.Working in a small team provides a unique opportunity to gain broad practical experience, learn from different aspects of the organisation, and see the direct results of your work and development.What we are looking for- Currently enrolled in a practice-oriented (HBO) programme, such as ICT / Information Technology, Business IT & Management, or Applied Data / Data & BI or- Currently enrolled in a Food Science related Master with substantial knowledge, expertise and experience on ICT / Information Technology, Business IT & Management, or Applied Data / Data & BI- Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken)- Practical and solution-oriented mindset- Strong working experience with Excel, with the ability and motivation to further improve and professionalise how data is structured and used within the organisation- Interested in improving workflows and learning more advanced data techniques- Able to work independently in a small team environment- Curious and proactive, with a “figure it out” mentalityWe offer- 36-hour working week- Hybrid work possible, with a minimum of 3 days per week at the office- Monthly compensation of EUR 350 gross; travel by public transport is reimbursed- Starting date: September 2026; contract period: 5-6 months
